name: macOS software installation sources
description: Install Mac applications through the Mac App Store or the software publisher's official signed/notarized distribution. Common package types include PKG and DMG; USB storage does not bypass Gatekeeper or licensing.
license_note: Applications remain subject to each developer's licence and distribution terms.
notes: Prefer Mac App Store or the developer's official website.
Check Intel versus Apple silicon compatibility.
A USB copy does not guarantee offline activation or dependencies.
